name: ARA-EXP-PRE-002
title: Mobile requires NativeAOT
summary: An Android or iOS preset selected a script lane other than NativeAOT. Preset validation blocks export.
html:
An Android or iOS preset selected a script lane other than NativeAOT. Preset validation blocks export.

#Common causes

  • The mobile preset sets lane to readyToRun.

#Fixes

  • Set lane to nativeAot, or omit it to use the default; ReadyToRun is a desktop lane.

  • Code: ARA-EXP-PRE-002 (slot 8009)

  • Constant: export::PRE_002

  • Reported by: ara-export
